title: Trend Lines
caption:
The simplest tool on any chart is a straight line.

In an uptrend, connect one swing low to the next. That's your trend line. A third bounce makes more traders trust it. And when price breaks below it, that's a warning the trend may be ending. Not a guarantee, but a reason to pay attention.

Trend lines are one of the drawing tools on Meme Street. Practise at memestreet.net

Fictional market. Not investment advice.
